hints.title: Water above a bar
hints.body: The water above a bar is the smaller of the tallest bars on its left and right, minus its own height.

hints.title: Two pointers
hints.body: Walk from both ends toward the middle while tracking the tallest bar seen on each side.

hints.title: Move the shorter side
hints.body: The shorter side determines the water level, so process it and advance that pointer.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
left = 0, right = n - 1
leftMax = 0, rightMax = 0, water = 0
while left < right:
    if heights[left] < heights[right]:
        leftMax = max(leftMax, heights[left])
        water += leftMax - heights[left]
        left += 1
    else:
        rightMax = max(rightMax, heights[right])
        water += rightMax - heights[right]
        right -= 1
return water
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
